entries.name: Old/example006.scad

comparison.message: volume: Δ=1327.878135 (rel 0.001425); surface area: Δ=119.910991 (rel 0.001957); bbox IoU: 0.997809 (need > 0.999000); centroid distance: 0.014103

entries.knownDifference: Smooth BREP fillet vs OpenSCAD inscribed faceted hull: hull() of the eight corner spheres is built as an exact BREP fillet, so the candidate is the true rounded cube (bbox exactly 100^3, volume = analytic 931 604.7) while OpenSCAD hulls its own faceted spheres and lands 0.12 % under it (bbox 100 x 99.8904^2). The boxes therefore differ as well as the volume. Geometry verified correct (all 21 dimples present). Documented in conefix plan §7.2.
